statement.p: The equation of the line that goes through the points ( -4 ,7 ) and ( 10 ,-10 ) can be written in the form y = mx+b where

solution.p: First, we need to find the slope of the line using the formula: m = \frac{y_2 - y_1}{x_2 - x_1} = \frac{-10-7}{10 + 4} = {-{\frac{17}{14}}}

Then substitute this value of m and the point (-4,7) to get \begin{aligned} 7 \amp = {-{\frac{17}{14}}} (-4) + b \\ 7 \amp = {{\frac{34}{7}}} + b\\ \end{aligned}
Subtracting \displaystyle{{{\frac{34}{7}}}} to both sides {{\frac{15}{7}}} = b
